name: Mercer University

programs.title: Direct Admit Graduate
programs.summary: If you meet Mercer University’s entry requirements, you can enrol directly into your chosen graduate program and begin your academic journey from day one.

description: Mercer’s graduate programs are offered at two unique campuses in Georgia. At the Atlanta campus, business students benefit from proximity to Fortune 500 companies. In Macon, engineering students enjoy a campus all about innovation in a city that offers a vibrant, historic setting with a lower cost of living.
